title: YU11-aeron-replication architecture
description: Dual-capable BLP replication: File-backed NATS remains the default and rollback path, while Aeron reliable unicast plus SBE and per-pod Archive sidecars provide a measured replication alternative, exact follower-journal durable watermarks, shadow validation, Archive catch-up, and an opt-in direct-heartbeat plus atomic-witness failover path.
inheritsFrom: YU10-fix-ingress (which inherits the full YU02..YU09 LMAX/Kubernetes lineage)

nodes.label: REST + FIX ingress
nodes.description: Unchanged YU10 entrypoints publish authorized commands onto the multi-producer input ring.

nodes.label: Primary input ring
nodes.description: Existing Disruptor ring. Journaler and selected replication handler consume in parallel; matching/risk waits behind both.

nodes.label: Primary Journaler + PVC
nodes.description: Business durability authority. Forces drained batches before journaledSeq advances.

nodes.label: Delegating replication selector
nodes.description: BLP_REPLICATION_TRANSPORT selects NATS or Aeron; optional Aeron shadow runs with NATS authoritative.

nodes.label: File-backed NATS replication
nodes.description: Inherited default and rollback path using TRADERX_BLP_REPLICATION plus follower ACK subject.

nodes.label: AeronReplicator + SBE encoder
nodes.description: Claims publication buffers and writes fixed 64-byte input records in place; tracks durable ACKs and policy state.

nodes.label: Primary Archiving Media Driver
nodes.description: Reliable unicast media driver plus Archive recording on the primary pod PVC under a one-core budget.

nodes.label: Follower Archiving Media Driver
nodes.description: Receives/records live data and serves/consumes replay for follower catch-up.

nodes.label: AeronReplicationFollower
nodes.description: Validates handshake/schema/epoch/sequence, decodes into the follower input ring, and maintains fixed sequence mappings.

nodes.label: Follower input ring
nodes.description: Existing Disruptor topology for journal and matching/risk apply.

nodes.label: Follower Journaler + PVC
nodes.description: Advances the exact post-force journaled watermark consumed by the durable ACK agent.

nodes.label: Follower matching/risk apply
nodes.description: Applies replicated inputs after journaling; applied watermark is independently required for promotion readiness.

nodes.label: Durable ACK agent
nodes.description: Coalesces highest contiguous mapped sequence at or below Journaler.journaledSeq and returns epoch/sequence/recording position.

nodes.label: Snapshot bundle + Archive replay
nodes.description: Checksummed bootstrap boundary and recorded tail used for retained-volume and empty-volume follower catch-up.

nodes.label: Kubernetes Lease
nodes.description: Synchronous default promotion authority and asynchronous reconciliation backstop in fast-witness mode.

nodes.label: NATS KV fast witness
nodes.description: Atomic compare-and-set tiebreaker after direct heartbeat staleness; exact revision/epoch enters the admission fence.

nodes.label: Primary admission fence
nodes.description: Opens only for a current default Lease proof or fast witness revision; closes on foreign or ambiguous proof before ring claim.

edges.label: record live data and snapshot streams
